home.rulesBody: Custom shipping rates are on the way. Rules, rate tables and the cart simulator will appear here.
home.testModeBody: Add sugarship to the shipping address at checkout to see Sugar Ship test rates. Real customers won't see them.

zones.title: Zones
zones.noRestOfWorldBody: Addresses outside your zones won't get Sugar Ship rates. Add a Rest of world zone to cover them.
zones.emptyBody: Zones group the countries and states you ship to, like India or Europe. You'll set a price for each zone when you create a rate.
zones.restOfWorldHelp: Covers every country and state that isn't in another zone.
zones.restOfWorldTaken: {{zone}} is already your Rest of world zone.
zones.deleteBody: This zone will be deleted. This can't be undone.
zones.deleteBodyRates_one: This zone and its {{count}} rate will be deleted. This can't be undone.
zones.deleteBodyRates_other: This zone and its {{count}} rates will be deleted. This can't be undone.
zones.errorsTitle: Fix these to save the zone
zones.errorStatesRequired: Choose at least one state for {{country}}.
zones.errorRestOfWorldExists: {{zone}} is already your Rest of world zone.
zones.errorInvalid: Something went wrong. Reload the page and try again.

rates.title: Rates
rates.emptyBody: Choose what customers pay to ship to each of your zones, for example a flat price at home and a higher one abroad. You can add rules like free shipping over an amount later.
rates.noZonesHeading: Add a zone before you set rates
rates.noZonesBody: Rates are priced per zone, so first tell Sugar Ship which countries and states you ship to.
rates.activeHelp: Inactive rates are never shown at checkout.
rates.customNameHelp: Shown exactly as typed, in every language.
rates.pricesHelp: Turn on each zone where this rate is offered and choose how it's priced there.
rates.deleteBody: Customers will no longer see this rate. This can't be undone.
rates.errorsTitle: Fix these to save the rate
rates.errorCustomNameRequired: Enter the name customers will see.
rates.errorDaysInvalid: Delivery days must be whole numbers from 0 to 365.
rates.errorPricesRequired: Enter a price for at least one zone.
rates.errorZoneUnknown: A zone in this rate no longer exists. Reload the page.
rates.errorZoneDuplicate: A zone in this rate no longer exists. Reload the page.
rates.errorInvalid: Something went wrong. Reload the page and try again.
rates.errorConditionUnsupported: Condition {{number}} can't be used here. Remove it and add it again.
rates.errorConditionWeightInvalid: Condition {{number}}: enter a weight in kg, with up to 3 decimals.
rates.errorConditionQuantityInvalid: Condition {{number}}: enter a whole number of items.
rates.quantityHelp: Counts each unit, e.g. 2 T-shirts + 1 cap = 3.
rates.whenAlways: This rate always applies. Add a condition to limit it, for example free shipping when the cart subtotal is at least a set amount.
rates.conditionsAtLimit: You can add up to 10 conditions.
rates.errorPricingBasisInvalid: {{zone}}: choose what the price is based on.
rates.errorBandsRequired: {{zone}}: add at least one price band.
rates.errorBandsStartAtZero: {{zone}}: the first band must start at 0.
rates.errorBandNotContinuous: {{zone}}, band {{band}}: must start where band {{previous}} ends.
rates.errorBandOpenNotLast: {{zone}}, band {{band}}: only the last band can be left open (“and above”).
rates.errorBandRangeInvalid: {{zone}}, band {{band}}: enter a valid range, with “to” above “from”.
rates.errorStepSizeInvalid: {{zone}}: the step size must be more than 0.
rates.errorStepPriceInvalid: {{zone}}: enter a valid price per step.
rates.errorPercentInvalid: {{zone}}: enter a percentage above 0 and up to 100, with at most 2 decimals.
rates.flatHelp: Every cart pays this price. Enter 0 for free shipping.
rates.bandsAtLimit: You can add up to 20 bands.
rates.bandsHelp: Each band starts where the one above ends. Leave the last “To” empty to cover everything above it.
rates.incrementalHelp: The base price covers the first step. Example: base 40, step 1 kg, 15 per extra step: a 3 kg cart pays 40 + 2 × 15 = 70.
rates.descriptionHelp: Shown under the rate name at checkout, e.g. Tracked and insured.
rates.errorDescriptionTooLong: Use 100 characters or fewer for the description.
rates.errorProductValueTooLong: Condition {{number}}: each value can be up to 255 characters.

simulator.title: Cart simulator
simulator.intro: Try an address and a cart to see which rates customers would get, and why the others don't show.
simulator.noZone: This address isn't in any of your zones.
simulator.noneShown: Customers would see no Sugar Ship rates for this cart.
simulator.fallbackShown: They'd get your fallback rate instead: {{name}} at {{price}}.
simulator.noFallback: No fallback rate is on, so they'd see only Shopify's own rates, if any.
simulator.reasonNoZone: This address isn't in any of your zones
simulator.reasonNotPriced: Its price for this zone couldn't be worked out
simulator.reasonUnsupported: Has a condition Sugar Ship can't check yet
simulator.errorWeightInvalid: Enter a weight in kg, with up to 3 decimals.
simulator.errorQuantityInvalid: Enter a whole number of items, 1 or more.

history.title: History
history.intro: Every time a customer reaches shipping, Shopify asks Sugar Ship for rates. Here's what we answered.
history.emptyBody: Checkouts appear here after a customer reaches the shipping step.
history.noMatchesBody: Try another result or show all checkouts.
history.noRatesReturned: We returned no rates for this checkout.
